description: youtube: Video/Short Details. GET /v1/youtube/video. Get YouTube video or Short details, description cards, AI disclosures, owner/uploader identities, paid-promotion status and replay heatmaps. Age-restricted videos return 403. No hosted video downloads. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

language.description: Preferred two-letter response language, such as en, es, or fr. Sets Accept-Language; YouTube may ignore it.
